short_blurb: Licensed Class B builder serving Paramount — remodels, ADUs & more.
local_note: Whether you're modernizing a kitchen, adding a primary suite, converting a garage, or building an ADU, Palm Crest Builders brings licensed, code-compliant construction to Paramount. As a Class B general building contractor we coordinate every trade under one contract and keep your project on schedule and on budget. We build throughout Paramount, including Paramount proper, Clearwater, Bellflower adjacent, and nearby neighborhoods.

faqs.q: Do you pull building permits in Paramount?
faqs.a: Yes — we handle plans, plan check, and permits through the Paramount building and safety department for every remodel, addition, and ADU, and we schedule all required inspections.

faqs.q: Can I build an ADU in Paramount?
faqs.a: In most cases, yes. Under California and Paramount rules, most single-family lots qualify for a detached, attached, or garage-conversion ADU. We handle feasibility, design, permits, and construction.

faqs.q: How long will my Paramount remodel or addition take?
faqs.a: It depends on scope — bathrooms typically run 3–5 weeks, kitchens 4–8 weeks, and room additions 2–4 months. We give you a firm schedule with milestones in your written estimate.
